title: Grand Canyon Basin ROUTE 66 Scenic Drive Crozier Canyon & Lunch
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Grand Canyon Basin and Colorado River shoreline on this comprehensive 8-hour tour. Travel along the only road leading to the canyon's bottom, taking in breathtaking views and unique desert landscapes. Enjoy a delicious lunch while learning about the region's rich cultural heritage and history as you drive along the iconic Route 66. This small group tour offers personalized attention and flexible stops for memorable photo opportunities.

- Duration: Approximately 8 hours with custom pickup
- Includes lunch, purified water, and sanitized transportation
- Group size is flexible; larger parties can call to book
- Ideal for ages 9 and up, with opportunities for spontaneous scenic stops
